notes: ACCESS: www.lightology.com returns HTTP 404 'Blocked' (Barracuda WAF, reason GEO_IP_BLOCK) on direct fetch, and r.jina.ai hit a Cloudflare challenge page. Working route: translate.goog proxy (https://www-lightology-com.translate.goog/...?_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=fr&_x_tr_hl=en), HTTP 200, full HTML. robots.txt itself returned the same Blocked page (no Claude-specific disallow could be read; proceeded per Rule 2 side-door guidance since the block is a generic geo/WAF block, not a targeted bot opt-out). COUNT METHOD: site is a custom (non-Shopify/Magento) PHP catalogue (index.php?module=cat&cat_id=N). No reliable total-count field/JSON was exposed; used product-card DOM count (class='col-md-4 prod-border', confirmed 1 card = 1 unique item_id/SKU) on page 1, found the last pagination page number from the pager widget, fetched that exact last page, and computed total = per_page*(last_page-1) + last_page_count. Verified the pager truly caps there by requesting one page beyond the shown max and confirming the site clamps back to the same last page (tested on cat_id=106 Pendants: requesting page=335 silently served page 334). ONE EXCEPTION FLAGGED: Pendants (cat_id=106) computed to exactly 10000 (334 pages x 30 + 10) - an exactly-round number matching a common search-index max_result_window cap; flagged null+MANUAL REVIEW rather than trusted, per Rule 1 (capped totals are not exact). All other totals were non-round, natural-looking numbers. STRUCTURE DISCOVERY: roughly a third of the nav's direct category links (e.g. cat_id 12,17,18,13,432,612,25,21,22,23,20,27,485,33,575,55,56,58,679, and Track & Rail's 115/119/117/671/576) render as landing pages with zero product cards but DO contain subcategory tiles (col-md-3 cat) leading to further, differently-numbered cat_ids (brand- or sub-type-specific) that hold the actual products - recursively crawled these (up to 4 levels deep, e.g. Track & Rail > Track System 120V > Juno Master Trac > Trac-Master Heads) rather than reporting them as empty. Several of these rollups are themselves aliases of each other under different cat_ids (identical child tile sets) - e.g. cat_id 115 and 538 both list the same 7 brand children, and Track&Rail's Outdoor Track (679) = Ceiling's Track > Outdoor Track (542) = the same PureEdge(63)/WAC(678) pages; each underlying product-bearing cat_id was counted exactly once. cat_id=504 (Lighted Mirrors) HTTP-redirects to cat_id=32 (Mirror With Light) (confirmed via final_url) - exact duplicate, dropped. A cluster of 8 LED-strip cat_ids (658,616,617,192,473,528,521,570) is cross-listed identically under 4 different parent menus (Ceiling Strip Lighting, Cabinet/Under Counter Lighting, Display Lighting, Bath Strip Lighting) - counted once under Ceiling > Strip Lighting. RULE 0 GAINS: found a genuine, separate Home Decor sub-tree (cat_id=491, reached only via the Furniture nav item, not the Lighting mega-menu) containing Wall Decor, Planters & Vases, Clocks & Watches, and Decorative Accents - all in-scope decorative-accessory categories with real product counts, plus a separate Decorative Mirrors (cat_id=572) leaf. Also traversed Lighting 'by room' - the module=shop_by_room_* pages are pure marketing/inspiration landing pages with zero independent product grids; every link on them points back into the same cat_id product pages already captured under the type tree, so per Rule 0 this is a pure facet re-cut (not a genuine independent room branch) and was not emitted as a separate hierarchy. EXCLUSIONS APPLIED: Bulbs (cat_id=72, entire branch), Fans (cat_id=6, entire branch incl. Outdoor Ceiling Fans and Bath Exhaust Fans/Heat Lamps), Furniture (Seating/Tables/Storage/Office Furniture/Outdoor Furniture/Rugs under cat_id=486), and hardware/parts/wiring items throughout the Lighting tree (Canopies, Freejack Canopies, Retrofit Kits, Dimmers/Light Controls, Transformers/Power Supplies, 12V Transformers, generic Lighting Accessories/Outdoor Lighting Accessories shade-lens-cord parts, and every Track & Connectors/Stem Kits/Transformers/Accessories/Hardware child found while crawling the track-system brand sub-trees). Home Fragrance, wallpaper, holiday/gift, textiles, and kitchenware were not found on this site (it is a pure lighting + small home-decor specialist) so no exclusion rows were needed for those categories. DUPLICATE-COMPANY CHECK: no evidence this storefront is a duplicate of another company already in the project (Lightology is an independent Chicago-based online/showroom lighting retailer).
